newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus crude oil stocks may run out in 4-5 days.
newsitem.headline: Belarus crude oil stocks may run out in 4-5 days.

text.p: Belarus's crude oil stocks may run out in four or five days because Russian oil companies have not increased supplies to the former Soviet republic, a senior energy official said on Monday.
"Our oil reserves will be enough only for four or five days," Vladimir Prokopchuk, vice president of state oil concern Belnefteprodukt, told Reuters.
This month Russian companies reduced oil supplies to 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes a day, compared to 35,000-40,000 daily at the beginning of the year.
Belarus imports 10-12 million tonnes of Russian oil annually for domestic needs.
